current_service.current_loader_scope: Flood classifier only: input shape 10, FLOOD_PROBABILITY output, approved manifest and risk-policy lifecycle.

deployment.dockerfile_artifact_behavior: COPY ml/flood-risk/artifacts into the image build context; ignored candidate files are absent from a normal Git checkout unless intentionally supplied to the build context.
deployment.security_observation: Compose currently sets CIVENTRAL_AI_ALLOW_PUBLIC_BIND=true while relying on private-network exposure. Phase 3F-B should remove that override or document the private firewall boundary before service integration.
deployment.review_conclusion: The AI service is private by Docker networking today, but the explicit public-bind override should be tightened in implementation.

recommended.recommendation: After separate governance approval, intentionally version the small validated Softplus model/preprocessing/manifest bundle in the deployment source revision so Dokploy builds are reproducible and checksum-verifiable.
recommended.security: Acceptable after repository sensitivity review; model contains no credentials or citizen data.
recommended.deployment_simplicity: HIGH; existing Dockerfile already copies ml/flood-risk/artifacts.
recommended.rollback: HIGH; Git/Dokploy revision rollback restores the exact bundle.
recommended.checksum_verification: Required at startup and should match the governed Phase 3E2/3E1 checksums.
recommended.dokploy_compatibility: HIGH; existing Compose Git deployment already builds from the repository.
recommended.phase_3fa_action: Review only; do not stage, commit, or force-add the ignored bundle in Phase 3F-A.

alternatives.assessment: Possible but weaker reproducibility and rollback; volume provenance and checksum lifecycle must be managed outside the current repository contract.
No existing supported artifact-injection mechanism was found in the current repository; do not invent one for the capstone.
No existing ML artifact registry is present; not recommended for this project review.

model_loading_policy.reason: The existing TensorFlowModelRuntime validates the flood classifier contract and cannot load the 57-feature Softplus rainfall bundle without a separate rainfall runtime contract.
startup_checks: Feature count equals 57 and exact Phase 3C feature order matches.
Architecture is Dense(64, ReLU), Dense(32, ReLU), Dense(1, Softplus), parameter count 5825.
Private research inference authorization is explicitly present before serving.
model_loading_policy.fail_closed_behavior: Do not serve rainfall inference when any startup check fails. Do not change global flood /ready semantics.

research_inference_authorization_design.governing_record: A distinct rainfall-regression runtime manifest/authorization should be introduced in Phase 3F-B; do not overload flood training_authorization or the flood model manifest.

authentication.current_mechanism: X-CIVENTRAL-AI-Key shared internal key with constant-time comparison via InternalAuthenticator.
authentication.configuration: CIVENTRAL_AI_INTERNAL_KEY from environment/Dokploy; minimum 32 characters; never logged or exposed to browser clients.
authentication.recommendation: Reuse this mechanism for the future private rainfall route; do not introduce a second secret system in Phase 3F-B.
authentication.caller_scope: Server-to-server internal callers only; citizen/mobile clients must not call flood-risk-ai directly.

error_contract.message_policy: Return stable public error codes and sanitized messages; never expose paths, checksums beyond approved metadata, stack traces, secrets, or request history.

readiness_design.recommendation: Keep global GET /ready unchanged at HTTP 503 MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE until the existing flood-runtime contract is separately approved.
readiness_design.rainfall_readiness: Use a separate future private GET /rainfall/ready or internal status field for rainfall candidate availability; do not conflate it with flood-model readiness.

lifecycle_and_rollback.promotion: Manual only after checksum, authorization, and private-service review; no automatic promotion.
lifecycle_and_rollback.rollback: Select the previous approved deployment revision or disable rainfall authorization; never silently fall back to a different model bundle.
lifecycle_and_rollback.disable_switch: A distinct rainfall inference authorization/configuration flag should disable the route while leaving global flood readiness unchanged.
lifecycle_and_rollback.checksum_failure: Mark rainfall runtime unavailable and refuse prediction.

phase_3fb_scope: Create a separate rainfall model runtime and manifest schema.
Reuse InternalAuthenticator and private Docker-network routing.
Implement POST /rainfall/predict with the history contract.
Implement separate rainfall readiness/status semantics without changing flood /ready.
Add checksum/feature/Softplus architecture validation and fail-closed errors.
Add private request/response and monitoring tests.
Keep MGB fusion, flood probability, public exposure, and operational activation out of scope.
